summary: Iteration 10 full-stack test of the fleet-dataset refactor. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10.py (44 tests) covering /api/healthz seed count, auth gating on all 9 fleet endpoints, /fleet/categories (8 cats, real site/asset/capacity counts), /fleet/kpis (all + category filter + unknown category), /fleet/sites (fields, pagination, category/state/search filters), /fleet/sites/{id} detail + 404, /fleet/telemetry (rows, sliding offset verified with 35s gap, unknown site, 422 validation), /fleet/alarms (default, severity filter, 422 on invalid, root_causes), /fleet/work-orders (+status filter, breakdown), /fleet/states (sorted, category filter), /fleet/performance/trend, plus legacy regression (/portfolio/metrics 4 findings, /auth/me, /portfolios, /alerts, /snapshots, /actions, /team/users, /reports/schedule, /reports/branding) and a live SSE check of POST /api/ai/insight (streamed deltas OK). Full suite: 125/128 passing (3 failures are real product bugs listed below). Frontend (Playwright, admin creds): login -> /dashboard, CategorySwitcher renders all 8 categories, 6 KPI cards populated with real aggregates (31.57 MW / 94.9% PR / 143.7 MWh / 541 alarms / 102 WOs / $809), clicking 'Wind Farm' correctly re-scoped KPIs (5.26 MW, 30 sites, 251 assets) AND the sites table (20/20 rows Wind Farm), sites-search filters to S00001 and shows sites-empty for no match, alarms severity filter + 5 root-cause pills work, WorkOrdersCard shows 141 total with Created/Assigned/Dispatched/Resolved breakdown, Share snapshot returns a /s/<token> link, site-open-S00001 navigates to /site/S00001 with all 8 site-* panels + working site-back, /site/NOPE123 renders site-not-found, AI panel streams a Claude answer and history tab lists past prompts, theme tokens match the origin palette (--bg #ffffff, --ink #071c14, --brand #18a866, --brand-3 #087346), dark toggle works both ways, /alerts /reports /team still load. Zero JS console/page errors.

critical.issue: Returns RAW per-asset rows and treats `hours` as a ROW COUNT, not hours. S00001 has 288 rows = 24 timestamps x 12 assets, so hours=24 returns only ~2h of data interleaved across 12 assets, and ~50% of sliding-window offsets land on night hours where power_kW/expected_power_kW are all 0 -> the SiteDetail chart renders a flat zero line. Fix: $group by timestamp with $sum power_kW/expected_power_kW, then slice the last N distinct hours. Also 2 of 380 sites (S00379/S00380 range) have no telemetry rows at all.

When the category matches 0 sites, site_ids is empty so the perf/alarm/WO/asset $match dicts stay empty and the endpoint returns FLEET-WIDE aggregates (asset_count=5473, alarms_total=800, PR=94.9) with site_count=0. Any typo/unknown category silently reports the whole fleet. Guard with an explicit empty-result short circuit.

minor.issue: Query pattern is ^(Low|Medium|High)$ but the seeded dataset contains 'Critical' alarms -> 422; Critical alarms cannot be filtered anywhere. Add Critical to the pattern.
status_breakdown aggregation has no $match, so it always returns the global breakdown even when status/site_id filters are applied (verified identical for ?status=Resolved).

Loads every in-scope site into memory (to_list(2000)) and uses a 380-element $in for 5 sub-queries per request, polled every 5s by the dashboard. Will not scale past 2000 sites; prefer a single $lookup/facet pipeline.

ui_bugs.issue: Chart renders as an empty band with a flat line and 'Peak 1 kW' because the telemetry payload is all zeros/per-asset (see backend telemetry bug). Reproduced on S00001 and S00002.

Full-screen backdrop (fixed inset-0 z-50) blocks every dashboard control until the tour is dismissed (Playwright clicks on category chips/alarm tabs were intercepted). Step 1 also targets the removed testid 'kpi-portfolio-health', so the spotlight no longer anchors to any element after the Dashboard rewrite.
No 'Critical' severity tab and SEV_STYLE has no Critical entry, so Critical alarms fall back to the green 'Low' styling — a Critical alarm is displayed in success-green.
Hardcoded stale copy 'LIVE · MONITORING 128 ASSETS' — dataset now has 5,473 assets / 380 sites.
Performance ratio is rendered unclamped, e.g. S00002 shows 101.0% (201/199 kWh). Clamp or label as >100% data artifact.

integration_issues.issue: CategorySwitcher only drives FleetKpiCards and SitesTable. AlarmsFeed and WorkOrdersCard are mounted without the category prop, so with 'Wind Farm' selected the page still shows '800 matching alarms' and '141 total work orders' next to 30-site Wind Farm KPIs — inconsistent dashboard state. Pass `category` down (backend /fleet/alarms and /fleet/work-orders also need a category param, they only accept site_id).

issues: document.scrollWidth exceeds clientWidth by 260px — horizontal page overflow; the KPI card row/grid does not collapse to a single column so cards are clipped off-screen
Alarm severity and asset-status badges use hardcoded light pastel hex values (#fee2e2/#fef3c7/#dff5e9) instead of theme tokens, so they don't adapt to the dark palette

action_items: Aggregate /api/fleet/telemetry by timestamp (sum power_kW / expected_power_kW across assets) and slide the window by hours, not by row index, so the SiteDetail chart shows a real daily curve instead of a flat zero line.
Short-circuit /api/fleet/kpis when the category matches 0 sites — it currently returns fleet-wide asset/alarm/PR aggregates.
Allow severity=Critical in /api/fleet/alarms and add a Critical tab + red styling in AlarmsFeed.
Add $match to the work-orders status_breakdown aggregation so it respects status/site_id filters.
Pass the selected category into AlarmsFeed and WorkOrdersCard (and add a category filter to those endpoints) so the whole dashboard is scoped consistently.
Fix OnboardingTour: update stale target 'kpi-portfolio-health' to an existing testid and make the backdrop non-blocking (or auto-dismiss on outside interaction).
Fix mobile horizontal overflow (260px) on /dashboard and update the stale 'MONITORING 128 ASSETS' string on the login page.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/fleet.py: the `if site_ids:` guard before building perf/alarm/WO/asset $match dicts is the root cause of the unknown-category data leak — an empty scope must produce empty results, not an unfiltered aggregate.
routers/fleet.py telemetry: `hours` is used as a row slice on per-asset documents; semantics of the parameter do not match its name and the result is not a per-site time series.

routers/fleet.py: alarm severity enum is duplicated as a regex in the route and as SEV_STYLE in AlarmsFeed.jsx; both drifted from the dataset (missing 'Critical'). Derive the allowed values from a shared constant/dataset distinct query.
routers/fleet.py list_sites: fetches all matching perf rows for the page's site ids with an unbounded find().sort('date',-1) and de-dupes in Python; use a $group/$first aggregation.

server.py CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False; acceptable for the Bearer/localStorage scheme in use, but the auth playbook's httpOnly-cookie requirement is not implemented (JWT is stored in localStorage under gs_token) — flagging as a deliberate deviation to confirm.

rca_of_the_issue: Flat/empty SiteDetail telemetry chart: fleet_telemetry stores one document per (timestamp, asset) — S00001 has 288 docs = 24 hourly timestamps x 12 assets. /api/fleet/telemetry sorts by timestamp and slices `hours` DOCUMENTS starting at offset=int(time.time()//30) % (total-window+1), so hours=24 returns 24 asset-level docs spanning only ~2 wall-clock hours, and whenever the offset lands in the night portion of the dataset every power_kW/expected_power_kW is 0. TelemetryChart then computes maxY=1.1 and draws a flat line at the baseline. Fix = aggregate by timestamp before windowing. Unknown-category KPI leak: fleet_kpis builds each secondary $match only `if site_ids:`; an unmatched category yields site_ids=[] so all four secondary queries run unfiltered and return fleet-wide totals.
